en: The Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, so a person weighing 120 pounds on Earth would weigh only 20 pounds on the lunar surface.
Ice has a friction coefficient of about 0.05, making it much slipperier than rubber tires on dry asphalt, which have a coefficient of 0.9.
A standard bottle opener acts as a second-class lever, multiplying your hand's applied force by about five times to easily pop off a metal cap.
Neodymium magnets are the strongest permanent magnets, capable of lifting up to 1,000 times their own weight in heavy iron objects.
A single lightning bolt can reach temperatures of 30,000 degrees Celsius, which is about five times hotter than the visible surface of the Sun.
Light travels at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second in a vacuum, taking about eight minutes to reach Earth from the Sun.
Sound travels through air at about 343 meters per second, but it travels over four times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
Water requires about five times more heat energy to warm up compared to the same mass of iron, giving it a very high specific heat capacity.
The Kingda Ka roller coaster accelerates from zero to 206 kilometers per hour in just 3.5 seconds, demonstrating a massive conversion of energy to motion.
A standard AA alkaline battery stores about 10,000 joules of chemical energy, enough to continuously power a small LED flashlight for roughly 50 hours.
An Archimedes screw can lift water up to three meters high for every single full rotation of its handle, efficiently moving heavy liquids upward.
A 500-kilogram roller coaster car at the top of a 60-meter hill possesses nearly 300,000 joules of gravitational potential energy before dropping.
